preconditions.description: The input x must be a number (int or float) or a string representing a number.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(x, str) and x != '' implies x.replace('.', '', 1).replace('-', '', 1).isdigit() or (x.startswith('-') and x[1:].replace('.', '', 1).isdigit())
preconditions.description: If x is a string, it must be a valid numeric string (integer or float, optionally negative).

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'It\'s hotter than the sun!!' if (float(x) ** 2) > 1000 else 'Help yourself to a honeycomb Yorkie for the glovebox.'
postconditions.description: If the square of x (converted to float) is greater than 1000, return the hot message; otherwise, return the Yorkie message.
